message.reasoning_content: We need to compare two yes/no questions. Q1: "Should Bill 2002/2019, which proposes more accessible criteria in life insurance contracts for the elderly, be approved?" Q2: "Should the manufacturer's responsibility to provide spare parts and technical assistance continue after the end of the product's expected useful life?" These are completely different topics: one about a specific legislative bill on life insurance for elderly; the other about manufacturer responsibility for spare parts after product life. Different measures, objects, scope. So relation = DIFFERENT. Provide reasoning.
